selected.title: Gemini 4 Argon reaches the public Gemini API: evaluate a frontier model for complex coding tasks
selected.summary: Google opened Gemini 4 Argon globally to developers and enterprises via the Gemini API on October 13, following a September 30 trusted-tester announcement. Builders can now compare it on a real complex coding task using the paid model ID gemini-4-argon.
selected.availability: Public paid Gemini API; Google AI Pro/Ultra in the Gemini app; Google AI Ultra in Antigravity. Introductory API prices run through November 30. Access and safeguards vary by surface.
selected.practical_use: Choose a representative multi-file coding task, evaluate Argon against an existing model using the same repository, instructions and review criteria, and inspect correctness and token cost before switching.

source_review.excerpt: now globally available to developers and enterprises via the Gemini API
source_review.decision: Read Google's October 13 launch, September 30 limited-access announcement and current API pricing. No live model call or independent benchmark performed.
source_review.availability: Paid Gemini API with model ID gemini-4-argon; app and Antigravity require separate Google AI subscription tiers.

openai.reason: October 14 GPT-6 software-maintenance article describes a useful internal method, not a newly released model. Retain as a potential professional method story.

anthropic.reason: October 14 posts are policy and office news; the latest Haiku 5.5 model was covered in the October 9 migration episode.

google.reason: October 13 made Gemini 4 Argon available through the Gemini API after the September 30 limited-access announcement. The paid model ID and introductory price are documented; claims of performance remain vendor claims.

repositories.reason: README and license checked; the October 14 discovery/crawl date alone does not establish an independent new release. Needs exact version and practical evaluation before a repository video.

architectures.reason: Kronecker Product Attention is an October 8 research-only paper; its reported compression is not a released flagship-model capability and requires a separate deep review.

playlist_review.reviewer: final editorial and digital publisher review
playlist_review.reason: The complete episode explains one verified Gemini 4 Argon model access change for builders: paid API eligibility, exact model ID, a controlled coding evaluation, cost boundary and no-live-test limitation. Every segment fits the models playlist.

editorial_review.context: models / builder / daily; Gemini 4 Argon public API opening on October 13
editorial_review.viewer_question: What changed in Gemini 4 Argon access, and when should a builder try it on a real coding task?
editorial_review.prerequisites: A paid Gemini API project and a representative, non-sensitive coding task with a known baseline.
editorial_review.central_task: Compare gemini-4-argon with an existing model on the same multi-file task and review correctness and token spend.
editorial_review.new_capability: The flagship Argon model moved from trusted-tester announcement on September 30 to globally available paid Gemini API access on October 13.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: All fourteen episode files and confirmed receipts reviewed; no prior Argon capability or access episode. Nano Banana image editing is a different model/task.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: A builder can now run an Argon evaluation on a real code task and decide whether its output justifies the paid model cost.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented launch and pricing review; no live Argon request or independent quality measurement.
editorial_review.alternatives: October 14 OpenAI maintenance article is a separate method; October 14 Anthropic posts are not model capabilities. OmO has no verified October 14 release; KPA is research-only.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: The actual public access change is recent, practical, primary-sourced and new to this archive. Avoid model superiority claims based on Google's internal demonstrations.
